name: policy-eval
description: Arsenal policy evaluation vectors. A policy authorizes a request if the requested scope is implied by at least one of the agent's granted scopes AND the request matches all of the policy's constraints (time-of-day, tenant, IP, etc.). These vectors exercise the core allow/deny decision logic.

vectors.name: allow-exact-scope-match
vectors.description: Request exactly matches a granted scope

vectors.name: allow-wildcard-covers-specific
vectors.description: A granted wildcard scope covers a specific request

vectors.name: allow-from-multiple-grants
vectors.description: Allow when any of the granted scopes implies the request

vectors.name: deny-unmatched-service
vectors.description: Deny when no granted scope covers the requested service

vectors.name: deny-unmatched-action
vectors.description: Deny when the action is not covered (read does not imply write)

vectors.name: deny-empty-grants
vectors.description: An empty grant set denies everything

vectors.name: allow-with-tenant-match
vectors.description: Policy allows when tenant constraint matches

vectors.name: deny-tenant-mismatch
vectors.description: Policy denies when tenant constraint does not match

vectors.name: allow-within-time-window
vectors.description: Request during the allowed time window is accepted

vectors.name: deny-before-time-window
vectors.description: Request before time window opens is denied

vectors.name: deny-after-time-window
vectors.description: Request after time window closes is denied

vectors.name: deny-wildcard-too-narrow
vectors.description: A specific-resource grant does not allow a different resource
